svg.title: Happy birthday, Trap — Arcade's graffiti mural

g.title: idzy
g.desc: happy birthday! we may not know each other that well, but i hope you have a wonderful day filled with happiness, laughter, and good memories. may this new chapter of your life bring you countless blessings, new opportunities, and everything your heart wishes for. wishing you nothing but the best. enjoy your special day! 🤍
